response.sql: SELECT language_id, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length >= 112 GROUP BY language_id ORDER BY avg_length DESC, language_id ASC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Films with NULL length are excluded by the length >= 112 filter. Ties on average running time are broken by language_id ascending, which is an arbitrary choice. Averages are unrounded. Only languages with at least one qualifying film appear. A language with no non-null length would give a NULL average, but the filter makes that impossible.
